# Every HTTP path nufi_app's ApiClient calls, as of nufi_app fc596f1
# (origin/master). One "METHOD /path" per line, relative to ApiClient.baseUrl
# (".../api/health"); Dart interpolations are replaced with the literal X.
#
# Regenerate from a nufi_app checkout with:
#
#   python3 - <<'EOF'
#   import re, pathlib
#   src = "".join(p.read_text() for p in
#                 pathlib.Path("lib/data/services/api").glob("*.dart"))
#   pat = re.compile(r"_client\.(get|post|put|patch|delete)\s*\(\s*'([^']*)'")
#   for m in sorted({(m.group(1).upper(),
#                     re.sub(r"\$\{[^}]*\}|\$[A-Za-z_]\w*", "X",
#                            m.group(2).split("?")[0]))
#                    for m in pat.finditer(src)}):
#       print(*m)
#   EOF
#
# The regex must tolerate newlines between "(" and the path: a line-based grep
# misses 27 of these, nearly every write call, because the body argument pushes
# the path onto its own line.
#
# This is the HTTP contract between the two repos -- the only real coupling
# (CONTEXT.md). tests/test_client_contract.py asserts every line here reaches a
# route. It cannot see paths the client adds after this snapshot, so refresh it
# when the client's API surface changes.
